data_processing.retention: Provider policy retains information only for the necessary purpose period or legal requirement, then deletes or anonymizes after purpose completion, confirmed deletion/cancellation, or service termination; exact API log duration is not separately stated.
data_processing.training_use: No model training or other use of provided text without prior consent; A-EXP-01 gives no training consent.

approval.authorization_reference: Current goal explicitly requests A-EXP-01 R0/R1/R2 execution and authorizes only bounded read-only runtime tools; this binding limits transfer to public non-sensitive frozen data and excludes truth/sealed data.
